6003,Misti Doi,10003,"Bengali Dessert",PT20M,PT12H 0M,PT12H 20M,2024-03-08,"A classic Bengali sweet yogurt dessert made by reducing whole milk and setting it with jaggery (or caramelized sugar) and a yogurt culture, typically in earthen pots for a unique flavor.","[Placeholder for Image URL]",Dessert|Sweet|Bengali|No-Bake,"Mishti Doi|Sweet Yogurt|Doi|Jaggery|Bengali",1|0.75|2|1|1,litre Whole Milk|cup Palm Jaggery (or Granulated Sugar)|tbsp Curd Starter (Yogurt Culture)|tsp Green Cardamom Powder (optional)|Earthen Pots/Bowls,4.8,38,250,"NA","NA","NA","NA","NA","NA","NA","NA",6,"6 servings","**Ingredients:** 1 Litre Whole Milk, 0.75 cup Palm Jaggery (or Granulated Sugar), 2 tbsp Curd Starter, 0.5 tsp Cardamom Powder (optional). **Instructions:** 1. **Reduce Milk:** In a heavy-bottomed pan, bring the whole milk to a boil.
